race.title: AWC Is Back Handicap
race.verdict: FRANKIES DREAM goes particularly well at this track and is easily excused a recent outing on soft going so he's liable to prove a real threat if things unfold well for him from stall 14. Intrusively is a recent course winner and showed better signs again last time so should be in the mix, while We Dare To Dream looks very well treated again now. FRANKIES DREAM (IRE) INTRUSIVELY WE DARE TO DREAM (IRE)
